card.fact_statement: Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner signed the Washington Peace Accords as the foreign minister of the DRC.
card.source_span: signed by the foreign ministers of the DRC and Rwanda, Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner and Olivier Nduhungirehe

target_qa_variants.question: Ni kiongozi gani muhimu aliyetia saini Makubaliano ya Amani ya Washington kwa wadhifa wake kama waziri wa mambo ya nje wa DRC?
target_qa_variants.source_span: signed by the foreign ministers of the DRC and Rwanda, Thérèse Kayikwamba Wagner and Olivier Nduhungirehe
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'key figure' to 'kiongozi muhimu' and 'Washington Peace Accords' to 'Makubaliano ya Amani ya Washington'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which important leader signed the Washington Peace Agreement in their capacity as the foreign minister of the DRC?
